notes.title: Rolling Back: Doodle Placement Precision Update Reversed Due to Technical Glitch
notes.content: Regrettably, we've had to roll back our latest update promising impeccable precision in Doodle placement due to unforeseen bugs. We're diligently addressing these issues and aim to have you enjoying a seamless experience soon. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding as we fine-tune this exciting feature! 🚀🛠️ #DoodleUpdate #TechnicalMaintenance

notes.title: --Hotfix localization problems
notes.content: --The game had some localization issues in the pause menu and has been fixed.

notes.title: Doodle Harmony Playthrough
notes.content:
Doodle Harmony is a beautiful Point and Click game.
100 pairs of doodles are waiting for you to match them.

Relax with a spectacular original soundtrack!

Found 2 matching ones? Drag them to their counterpart.

[h1]Features[/h1]
🧑🏻‍🤝‍🧑🏻 1 Level, 100 pairs of doodles♾️ Procedural Level Generation
🎶 Radio System to choose your music
⏰ Timer Mode with leaderboards
